periods.label: 天眼被一刀罗刹抢先击倒

status.condition: knocked unconscious at the starting line

personality.summary: A calculating observer whose pre-battle reading is strong enough to frighten Ikki into spending his trump card.

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Opponent; Byakuya's prediction would catch Ikki by the twenty-third move unless Ikki breaks the board immediately.

periods.summary: Byakuya's second-round match with Ikki ends instantly when Ikki opens with Ittou Rasetsu plus the sword method learned from Edelweiss. Publicly it looks like a one-sided record victory over last year's runner-up, but Ikki privately recognizes that Byakuya was dangerous enough that ordinary tactics would have led to capture by the twenty-third move. Byakuya's strength forces Ikki to spend his once-per-day trump card before facing Sara later that evening.

key_events.summary: Is defeated before moving, but his threat level shapes Ikki's later disadvantage.
